recent_en: OB Holdings released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026 on 30 October 2026, with net profit up 14.1% year-on-year to RM1.96 million while revenue fell 9.0% year-on-year.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 31 August 2026 rose 14.1% year-on-year to RM1.96 million, while revenue fell 9.0% year-on-year to RM14.49 million.
The company disclosed a material litigation matter (announcement dated 16 November 2026).
risks_en: The company disclosed a material litigation matter.
Director Lee Bao Yu reported dealings in the company's shares on 29 September 2026 (acquired 10,000 shares on that date, after disposing 30,000 shares on 30 March 2026).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM14.49 million, down 9.0% year-on-year and 21.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM1.96 million, up 14.1% year-on-year but down 21.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 13.5% versus 13.6% in the prior quarter.
